topic: Coca-Cola's secret formula and the New Coke failure

sources.claim: New Coke launched April 23, 1985; original formula returned as Coca-Cola Classic on July 11, 1985 (79 days later)
sources.source: Coca-Cola Company official history page ('New Coke: The Most Memorable Marketing Blunder Ever?'); History.com

sources.claim: Company received up to 8,000 calls a day and roughly 40,000 complaint letters
sources.source: History.com ('New Coke debuts, one of the biggest product flops in history')

sources.claim: Original Coca-Cola formula dates to 1886 (99 years before 1985)
sources.source: Coca-Cola Company official corporate history (widely corroborated founding date)
